title: Exact phase projections, preimage multiplicity, and compact existence certificates
status: Frozen before the new phase profiles; previously known global and restricted phase results inform this protocol

compact_certificate_test.rationale: Chosen by elementary symmetry and endpoint balancing before profile computation, not a blind search
compact_certificate_test.task: Independently check all unchanged distances and speed11 circular phase separation; derive a two-time certificate valid for every initial phase of11 if the margins permit it. Do not assume success or global optimality.

verification: Separate direct time-domain reconstruction for all algebraically generated critical phase points and every intervening cell; prove breakpoint completeness rather than treating sampled phases as a continuum proof
general_review: Audit covering-arc criteria for all-phase existence versus strictness, endpoint protection and quantitative margins. General claims require supplied arguments and remain proof candidates.
limits: Only two fixed velocity lists, exact finite algebraic phase partitions, the two predeclared time pairs, and at most one abstract representation countermodel. No new speed search, all-reference enumeration, arbitrary phase grid, outside contact, paid compute, novelty claim, or unlabelled change from common-start to shifted-start.
